headline: Abhishek Shivpujan Giri resigns as independent director of Heads UP Ventures
hook: Board departure at Heads UP Ventures
summary: Heads UP Ventures Limited has informed the stock exchange that Mr Abhishek Shivpujan Giri has resigned from his position as Non-Executive Independent Director, effective October 7, 2026. Independent director departures can impact corporate governance oversight at micro-cap companies. Retail investors holding shares in the company should monitor future board composition disclosures.
whats_next: Appointment of a replacement independent director
why_it_matters: Board changes require monitoring for governance and compliance oversight.

headline: Dhruvi Patel steps down as Company Secretary of Heads UP Ventures
hook: Leadership departure at Heads UP Ventures
summary: Heads UP Ventures Limited has informed the exchange that Mrs Dhruvi Patel has ceased to be the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the company, effective October 07, 2026. This is a routine secretarial change for the listed entity. Retail investors holding the stock should note the transition in key managerial personnel.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact on shareholders
